answer: No. The Larch pilot is no longer on November 12, 2026. The current approved schedule is November 26, 2026. The November 12 target was superseded by an October 23, 2026 decision, which the Larch Pilot page records as allowing completion of certificate renewal. The public launch date is undecided. The archive page records November 12 as the original target from an October 5 decision. Today is 2026-11-25, so the pilot is currently scheduled for tomorrow.
